findings.note: Alexander is listed among the co-sponsors of Senate Bill 88, Election Day Integrity Act (filed 2023-02-09). The bill changes the deadline for returning absentee ballots to 7:30pm on Election Day and sets county reporting of absentee ballot counts. It is about absentee ballot handling, not ID.
